description: This file defines a class 'StandardNormal' providing methods related to the standard normal distribution, including functions for cumulative distribution, inverse, and related statistical calculations within a PHP spreadsheet calculation library.

classes.name: StandardNormal
classes.description: A class providing calculations related to the standard normal distribution, such as cumulative probabilities, inverse calculations, and statistical tests.

methods.name: cumulative
methods.description: Returns the standard normal cumulative distribution function for a given value.

methods.name: distribution
methods.description: Returns the cumulative distribution function or probability density function of the standard normal distribution based on input flags.

methods.name: inverse
methods.description: Returns the inverse of the standard normal cumulative distribution (quantile function).

methods.name: gauss
methods.description: Calculates the probability that a standard normal variable falls within a certain range around the mean.

methods.name: zTest
methods.description: Performs a one-tailed Z-test, returning the p-value based on a dataset, mean hypothesized value, and optional standard deviation.
